verdict.rationale: Installing GPU vendor drivers and building custom kernel modules is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing about third-party GPU drivers, kernel extensions or custom kernel modules. The docs cover Continuity, Siri AI, Safari and file migration, and the community items cover unrelated bugs and CLI tips.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install GPU vendor drivers and build custom kernel modules for accelerated workloads
